cc:Work.dc:title: Linux Scatter Field v3 Light / dendogg Icon Set
cc:Work.dc:description: Watermark-weight scatter-field backdrop built entirely on Dennis 'dendogg' Smaltz's original faceted icon set, over Termux-authentic shell text fragments. Single-authored icon vocabulary; no third-party icon files embedded.
